purpose: paired source-bound component diagnostic on the already-exposed 16-project development partition

candidate_ocr.ocr_raster: ProductionRasterFrameDecoder; original unmasked raster and detected axis plot bounds

mask_comparison.candidate: same provider plus fixed test-only OutlineCoreCandidateProbabilityProvider from ArtifactMaskOutlineCoreCandidateTests
mask_comparison.seed: exact ProductionDetectionMaskComposer.BuildSeedMasks implementation invoked by source-bound reflection
mask_comparison.seed_limitation: V8 exposes a combined four-model OcrResult and not the two-model ProductionOcrEvidence execution receipts required by the composition wrapper; only receipt validation is bypassed for the diagnostic. Both paired providers receive byte-identical raster, axis, OCR result, and seed.

metrics.aggregation: aggregate only; no project IDs, paths, OCR text, points, images, or case-level values in output
metrics.point_metric: nearest-pixel Engauge marker-center sampling for baseline/candidate mask state changes
metrics.mask_metric: total masked pixel count and coverage across successfully paired rasters
metrics.limits: No complete marker masks or labeled negative structures; this cannot estimate precision or recall and is not production or sealed acceptance. The 16 studies were previously exposed development data; a prior paired execution is preserved as non-authoritative, so this run is a second development exposure.
